1.w: Wine [is] a mocker, strong drink a brawler, and anyone led astray by it is not wise.

2.w: The terror of a king [is] like the roaring of the young lion; the one making him angry is wronging his own soul.

3.w: An honor to a man is cessation from strife, and every fool will quarrel.

4.w: From autumn a lazy one will not will plow, and he begs in the harvest, and [there is] nothing.

5.w: Counsel in the heart of man [is] deep waters, and a man of understanding will draw it out.

6.w: Many a man proclaims, each man his loving devotion—and a man of faithfulness, who can find?

7.w: A righteous one is walking about in his integrity; blessed [are] his sons after him.

8.w: A king sitting on the throne of judgment is scattering all evil with his eyes.

9.w: Who can say, “I have made clean my heart; I have been cleansed from my sin?

10.w: A stone and a stone, an ephah and an ephah—the two of them alike [are] an abomination to YHWH.

11.w: Even by his deeds a child is known, whether his action [is] pure and upright.

12.w: The ear hearing, and the eye seeing—YHWH has made even both of them.

13.w: You should not love sleep, lest you be dispossessed; open your eyes, be satisfied [with] bread.

14.w: “Bad, bad,” says the one buying, and having gone away himself, then he boasts.

15.w: There is gold and an abundance of rubies, and the lips of knowledge [are] a precious vessel.

16.w: Take his garment when it has been pledged for a stranger, and hold it in pledge for a foreign woman.

17.w: The bread of deceit [is] sweet to a man, and afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.

18.w: Plans are established by counsel, and by guidance wage war.

19.w: The one going about [with] slander uncovers a secret; and do not pledge yourself to the one opening his lips.

20.w: One belittling his father or his mother, his lamp will be extinguished in the pupil of darkness.

21.w: An inheritance gained unjustly at first, even its latter end will not be blessed.

22.w: You should not say, “I will repay evil.” Wait for YHWH, and He will save you.

23.w: An abomination to YHWH [are] a stone and a stone, and scales of deceit [are] not good.

24.w: [From] YHWH [are] the steps of man; and how can a man understand his way?

25.w: [It is] a snare for a man to rashly declare “It is holy” and afterward to reconsider [his] vows.

26.w: Wise [is] a king scattering the wicked—he even turns the wheel over them.

27.w: The spirit of a man [is] the lamp of YHWH, searching all the chambers of the belly.

28.w: Loving devotion and faithfulness guard a king, and his throne is supported by loving devotion.

29.w: The glory of young men [is] their strength, and the splendor of old men, grey hair.

30.w: Stripes that wound scour evil, and beatings, the chambers of the belly.
